title: Alignment child process exceeded its deadline during concurrent validation
symptom: The final repository suite reported 570 passed, 5 skipped and 1 failed. alignment-only.test.ts:178 received a null child exitCode under a fixed 20-second deadline while packaging and installation checks also ran.

rootCause.summary: The child process exceeded the configured 20-second execution deadline; the unchanged test subsequently passed in a targeted retry. Concurrent load is a hypothesis for the slowdown, not an established root cause.

requestedOutcome: Establish whether the unchanged test and complete suite pass when expensive validation runs are serialized, preserving both the original failure and the retry evidence.
decisions: Retain the original timeout and full-suite failure as an observed result.
Run the unchanged targeted suite and then the full suite with expensive validation serialized.
Keep the deadline and implementation unchanged while investigating; a retry does not erase the failed attempt.

actions.description: Capture the failing full-suite output and run the unchanged targeted test suite.
Finish serialized full-suite validation and record its result.
Investigate the underlying deadline cause if it recurs during serialized validation; concurrent load remains an unconfirmed hypothesis.
